description: Arx Woo guard (card testing and fake accounts) for one hosted WooCommerce website (serviceId). get (default): the policy (mode off|monitor|protect, the recommended mode, whether WooCommerce was found, settings), whether the server routes the site through the guard, 7-day stats and the 50 latest events. set (confirm): mode and settings (window, ipSoft, ipHard, netSoft, netHard, blockMinutes for the server; failWindowMinutes, failSoft, failHard, blockHours, smallOrderAmount, smallOrderBurst, guestBurstSoft, guestBurstHard, newAccountDays, minCardOrder, registerPerIpHour, registerSiteHour, honeypot, disposable, exemptPaths, exemptNets for the shop; 0 turns a shop check off). monitor counts and reports, it never refuses. spam: customer accounts with no orders that look like spam sign-ups (removal is decided by Lanetti support).

action.description: get is default. set needs confirm. spam lists spam account candidates.

mode.description: set: monitor counts and reports only; protect challenges and blocks.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id (the WooCommerce site).

blockMinutes.description: Server: how long a checkout block lasts.

disposable.description: Refuse disposable email domains at sign-up.

exemptNets.description: Extra payment provider addresses or ranges never counted.

exemptPaths.description: Extra payment webhook paths never counted.

failHard.description: Shop: failed payments before checkout closes for that address and email.

failSoft.description: Shop: failed payments (address, email, card or session) before the browser check.

failWindowMinutes.description: Shop: window for counting failed payments.

guestBurstHard.description: Shop: failed guest orders in 10 minutes before the site-wide guest alarm is raised (0 = off). Guests are asked for the browser check, never paused.

guestBurstSoft.description: Shop: failed guest orders in 10 minutes before every guest solves the check (0 = off).

ipHard.description: Server: checkout calls per address before checkout is blocked.

ipSoft.description: Server: checkout calls per address before the browser check.

minCardOrder.description: Shop: minimum order total for card payments (0 = off).

netSoft.description: Server: the same for one /24 network.

newAccountDays.description: Shop: failures from accounts younger than this count double.

registerSiteHour.description: Shop: sign-ups per hour before new sign-ups solve the check.

smallOrderAmount.description: Shop: orders under this total count as small (EUR).

smallOrderBurst.description: Shop: small orders in 10 minutes that start a burst (0 = off).

window.description: Server: seconds the checkout score takes to fall by about two thirds.

name: oma_arx_woo_guard
title: Arx Woo guard
